description: The bar chart illustrates a "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment." The horizontal axis displays the categories, consisting of five models ordered as "Our Joint Framework", "ChatGPT", "DeepSeek", "LLaMA", and "Claude", with the labels slightly rotated and no overall axis title. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Runtime (seconds)", utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 400 with numeric tick labels and horizontal dashed grid lines at intervals of 50. A legend in the upper left corner specifies that dark green denotes "Our Joint Framework" and light blue denotes "LLM Models". The chart contains five vertical bars, each outlined in black and annotated with its exact value in bold text directly above it. The bars are not sorted by height. The first bar, "Our Joint Framework", is dark green and is the shortest, with an annotated value of 77. The subsequent four bars are light blue: "ChatGPT" has a value of 190, "DeepSeek" is the tallest bar at 365, "LLaMA" is 172, and "Claude" has an annotated value of 243, which is partially obscured by a small grey rectangular artifact. Visual emphasis is applied through the distinct color coding separating the joint framework from the LLM models, as well as the bold data labels above each bar.
